remarks: Discover the beautiful ambiance of this Spring Hill Condominium. When approaching you will have a single reserved parking space as well as visitors' access. The well-manicured gardens will lead you to your single level condo access. This spacious one bedroom, one full bath condo is not one to miss. The dining area is sun drenched with large windows. Fully renovated bathroom and new kitchen counters complete the aesthetic. In-house washer and dryer. Private patio and manicured gardens accessed from the bedroom and main entry. Complex complete with swimming pool. Convenient access to Merrit, 95, and SONO.
